text.description_html:
Cal-Royal JRS34, 4 Inch Jumbo Rigid Stop with Molded Screw

This 4 Inch Door Stop comes in a satin nickel finish. It is made out of die cast material and conforms to ANSI/BHMA A156.16 codes. The 4 Inch Door Stop with Molded Screw has a 3/4 inch mounting screw attached at the base.

Features and Specifications of the 4 Inch Doorstop:

  • Finish: Satin Nickel
  • Projection: 4"
  • 3/4" Mounting Screw attached at base.

Sold Individually
